notes: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md in full. Git reference for interactive rebase, cherry-pick, bisect (manual and automated), worktrees, reflog recovery, rebase-vs-merge, autosquash, splitting commits and recovery commands, with best practices such as backup branches and --force-with-lease.

Medium: following it has the agent rewrite history and push — `git push --force-with-lease` (SKILL.md:159, details.md:21), `git reset --hard` (SKILL.md:165, 193; details.md:97, 106), `git push origin` of a hotfix branch (details.md:82) — and run the user's tests via `git bisect run`. Acceptable because these are the standard operations for the user's own repository, the skill itself advises backup branches, rebasing only local commits and lease-protected force pushes; the agent should confirm before force-pushing or hard-resetting. Note `git rebase -i` needs an interactive editor.
No external file dependencies; references/details.md ships with the skill. `../project-feature` paths are example worktree locations, not links.
